about.p1: After several years in translation and IT project management, I naturally moved into development — a field I've always been passionate about. There I find the same rigor, attention to detail, and the satisfaction of turning an idea into a concrete, useful solution.
about.p2: Over the course of my journey, I have adopted an approach that is both technical and business-focused: I design solutions with a strong product mindset, I help technical and business teams collaborate effectively, and I support projects from idea to delivery with method and clarity.
about.p3: I am particularly interested in IT project manager, product owner or product lead roles, because they allow me to combine delivery, user understanding and hands-on execution. My training in cybersecurity (ANSSI, LinkedIn Learning) reinforces this approach centred on quality, security and continuity.
about.p4: Outside of coding, I find balance in sport and music — badminton, running, salsa and bachata punctuate my free time. Professionally, I continue to train in networking, cybersecurity and AI to complement my development specialisation with coherent, complementary skills.

projects.livret.title: Livret CDA
projects.livret.description: Web application to manage training sessions, users (profiles), skills and admin areas. It includes fixtures to populate data, controllers and Twig templates for the UI, as well as a PHPUnit test suite with coverage reports. The code is organised with Doctrine for persistence and includes generation/CI tooling.
projects.breakingcat.title: Breaking Cat
projects.breakingcat.description: Web mini-game accessible after authentication, with two game modes (Normal and Hardcore, the latter marked as inactive). The player starts a game and records their score, which feeds a leaderboard displayed on the homepage. The interface is responsive (Bootstrap) with a light/dark theme, and data (users/scores) are persisted in a MySQL database via PDO.

recommendations.linkedin.quote: I’ve known Jérémy since 2011 and I recently stopped collaborating with him on a daily basis. I already miss it! Jérémy is a highly committed team member, meticulous in his work and always ready to help others. He is passionate about his work and will always go the extra mile to find the right term, the perfect expression… He will not hesitate to get technical either, to report bugs, dive into code, variables and placeholders to ensure localization is as precise as possible.
